title: archive_signal failed in fix_signal post-resolution hook: a1000057-0606-4000-8000-000000000057
description: archive_signal: cannot archive 'a1000057-0606-4000-8000-000000000057' — status is 'in_progress' (must be 'resolved' or 'superseded'). The Archive Resolved Signal phase in fix_signal.skill.md is structurally mismatched with the current event-emission workflow: fix_signal now marks signals as in_progress and emits a signal.accepted event for downstream resolution, so the signal is never resolved within the fix_signal run itself. archive_signal will always fail at this phase under the current skill design.
proposed_resolution: Investigate and manually archive the signal record. Longer term: remove or gate the Archive Resolved Signal phase in fix_signal.skill.md — it belongs in the accepting workflow (accept_candidate or a post-run hook), not in fix_signal which only marks signals in_progress.
